# APPENDIX `r new_appendix()`. ADDITIONAL METADATA {#app:additional}

This appendix presents the transects set in 11 lakes. They are examples of the fixed areas repeatedly surveyed in the freshwater bodies across the ATS years.
```{r acoustic-gear-Cheewhat, tab.cap="Summary of Cheewhat Lake Sockeye ATS dates, transects and trawl completed, and acoustic gear."}
############ visualizing the data - survey effort and acoustics gear Hyatt 2000 table 1
### Create a survey_date in the trawl data set to merge with acoustic data
############## Read csv tables
Trawl_data <- read.csv("./00_data/Trawl_data_FINAL_1977-1999.csv")
lake_name <- read.csv("./00_data/lake_codes.csv")

### Global variables
lakes_of_interest <- c("Great Central Lake", "Sproat Lake (Two R)", "Sproat Lake", "Henderson Lake", "Kennedy Lake (Clay)", "Kennedy Lake (Main)", "Cheewhat Lake", "Muriel Lake", "Hobiton Lake", "Long Lake", "Long Lake (A)", "Long Lake (B)", "Owikeno Lake", "Tahltan Lake", "Meziadin Lake")


### Trawl
Trawl_data_renamed <- Trawl_data %>%
  mutate(survey_date = trawl_date)

# join acoustic and trawl tables
Trawl_acoustic_data <- full_join(Trawl_data_renamed, Acoustic_data, 
                                 by = c("ats_year", "lake_code", "survey_date", "lake_name"), 
                                 suffix = c("_Trawl", "_Acoustic"))

# Filter lakes and species of interest
Trawl_acoustic_data <- Trawl_acoustic_data %>%
  filter(lake_name %in% lakes_of_interest,
         #species_common_name %in% c("Sockeye", "Stickleback"),
         !gear_info %in% "DUM2",
         !life_stage %in% "Adult")

# Clean columns keeping only columns of interest
Trawl_acoustic_data_clean <- Trawl_acoustic_data %>%
  select(ats_year, lake_code, lake_name, trawl_date, survey_date, trawl_month, survey_month, 
         trawl_number, depth_m, depth_min_m, depth_max_m, species_code,
         species_common_name, life_stage, age_class, source_files, 
         transect, targets, prop_sockeye, prop_stickleback, sounder_code, sounder_type, acoustic_source_file)

# Create a summary table for sockeye
for (lk in lakes_of_interest) {
  
  df_lk <- filter(Trawl_acoustic_data_clean, lake_name == lk)
  
  Sockeye_summary_table <- df_lk %>%
    #filter(species_common_name %in% "Sockeye", !is.na(sounder_type), !is.na(transect), !is.na(trawl_number)) %>% # filter only sockeye species
    filter(species_common_name %in% "Sockeye") %>% # filter only sockeye species
    group_by(survey_date, ats_year, sounder_type) %>%
    mutate(Transects_completed = ifelse(!is.na(transect), n_distinct(transect), 0L),  # store the max transect number in that lake, that date
           Trawls_completed = ifelse(!is.na(trawl_number), n_distinct(trawl_number), 0L),   # count the distinct number of trawl events that day, in the specific lake
           Surface_trawl = ifelse(!is.na(trawl_number) & !is.na(depth_m), 
                                  n_distinct(trawl_number[depth_m == 0]), 0L)) %>% # extract only the trawl events when the depth was 0
    select("ATS date" = survey_date, "ATS year" = ats_year, "Sounder type"  = sounder_type, 
           "Transects completed" = Transects_completed, "Trawls completed" = Trawls_completed, "Surface trawls" = Surface_trawl) %>%
    mutate(`ATS year` = as.character(`ATS year`)) %>%
    distinct()
  
  assign(paste0(lk, "_summary_table"), Sockeye_summary_table)
}

# Plot the table
flextable::flextable(`Cheewhat Lake_summary_table`)|>
  flextable::separate_header() |>
  flextable::align(align = "center", part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

```

```{r landscape-lake-strata-table, tab.cap="Lake strata for the main surveyed lakes."}
lake_strata_table <- read.csv("00_data/Lake_strata_length.csv")

lake_strata_table <- lake_strata_table %>%
   filter(Lake.name %in% 
           c("Great Central Lake", "Sproat Lake (Two R)", "Sproat Lake", "Henderson Lake", "Kennedy Lake (Clay)", "Kennedy Lake (Main)","Cheewhat Lake", "Muriel Lake", "Hobiton Lake", "Long Lake", "Long Lake (A)", "Long Lake (B)", "Owikeno Lake", "Tahltan Lake", "Meziadin Lake")) %>%
  rename("Latitude" = Lake.latitude, "Longitude" = Lake.longitude, "Lake" = Lake.name, 
         "Length (m)" = Transect.length.m, "Area (ha)" = Area.ha, "Code" = Lake.code, 
         "Depth (m).Min" = Depth.min.m, "Depth (m).Max" = Depth.max.m) %>%
  mutate(`Area (ha)` = as.integer(`Area (ha)`),
         `Length (m)` = as.integer(`Length (m)`))

lake_strata_table$Latitude <- str_replace_all(lake_strata_table$Latitude, " deg", "°")
lake_strata_table$Latitude <- str_replace_all(lake_strata_table$Latitude, " min", "' N")

lake_strata_table$Longitude <- str_replace_all(lake_strata_table$Longitude, " deg", "°")
lake_strata_table$Longitude <- str_replace_all(lake_strata_table$Longitude, " min", "' W")

# Plot the table
flextable::flextable(lake_strata_table) |>
  flextable::separate_header() |>
  flextable::align(align = "center", part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

```
